MENU_QUICK_DESC: Nyika mbiri dzaunoda, nhandare yaunoda. Pasa yepakati ndeyako.
MENU_CUP_DESC: Nyika sere, mapoka maviri, masemi-fainari nefainari.
MENU_CUP_CONTINUE: Mukombe wako uri kuenderera. Ramba uchitamba.
MENU_HOWTO_DESC: Nhandare, nzvimbo nomwe nemitemo yose inodanwa nevatongi.
QUARTERS_NOTE: Mutambo chaiwo une zvikamu zvina zvemaminitsi 15. Wachi inoramba ichifamba pazvibodzwa, inomira chete kana pane akuvara.
DOUBLE_ZONE_NOTE: Mutemo weligi: mumaminitsi 5 ekupedzisira echikamu chega chega, chibodzwa chinobva pa3 m kana kupfuura chinopa zviviri.
DIFF_EASY_DESC: Vadziviriri vavo vanononoka kuona mapasa ako, uye havawanzo kuabvuta.
DIFF_NORMAL_DESC: Timu yekirabhu yakanaka: pasa isina kusimba vanoibvuta.
DIFF_PRO_DESC: Timu yenyika: vanokurumidza kuona mutambo, zvakaoma kuvapfuura nemapasa.
DIFF_LEGEND_DESC: Vakanyanya pasi rose. Pasa yega yega isina hanya inobvutwa.
BIB_TEAM_NOTE: Unotamba neane bhora, uye nemudziviriri ari pedyo naro.
PLAY_AS_NOTE: Timu: unotonga ane bhora. Nzvimbo imwe: sarudza bhibhi pachiratidziro chekutanga woitamba mutambo wose, sezvinoita mutambi.
KEEP_ONSIDE_NOTE: Hongu: mutambi wako anomira pamuganhu wenzvimbo dzaanobvumirwa kupinda. Kwete: ukayambuka mutsetse, mutongi anodana ofusaidhi.
POS_ROLE_GA: Anonwisa, anopa mupfuri bhora uye anomhanya nechikamu chepakati.
POS_ROLE_WA: Anopa denderedzwa bhora ari pamucheto waro; ndiye wekutanga kutarisirwa papasa yepakati.
POS_ROLE_C: Anotora pasa yepakati uye anobatanidza kudzivirira nekurwisa nhandare yose.
POS_ROLE_WD: Anorinda Wing Attack uye anovhara mapasa anopinda mudenderedzwa.
POS_ROLE_GD: Anorinda Goal Attack, mukati nekunze kwedenderedzwa.
POS_ROLE_GK: Anorinda Goal Shooter, anodzivirira kupfura uye anotora bhora rinodzoka.
POS_AREAS_GA: Nzvimbo: chikamu chepakati, chekurwisa nedenderedzwa regora.
POS_AREAS_WA: Nzvimbo: chikamu chepakati nechekurwisa, kwete denderedzwa.
POS_AREAS_C: Nzvimbo: zvikamu zvose zvitatu, kwete denderedzwa ripi neripi.
POS_AREAS_WD: Nzvimbo: chikamu chepakati nechekudzivirira, kwete denderedzwa.
POS_AREAS_GD: Nzvimbo: chikamu chepakati, chekudzivirira nedenderedzwa regora.
GFX_NOTE: Pasi zvinokodzera mafoni akachipa: hapana mitsetse yekunze, vataridzi vashoma. Otomatiki ikabatidzwa, mutambo unononoka mumasekondi ekutanga unoderera danho rimwe woga.
FPS_NOTE_SAVER: Mifananidzo inenge {n} pasekondi, midiki zvishoma: foni haipise uye bhatiri rinogara.
FPS_NOTE_SMOOTH: Mifananidzo {n} pasekondi pachiratidziro chako che{hz} Hz: zvinotsetseka, uye zvinochengetedza bhatiri kupfuura yepamusoro.
FPS_NOTE_MAX: Yose inoratidzwa nechiratidziro chako che{hz} Hz.
MOVE_BUTTONS_NOTE: Kweva bhatani rimwe nerimwe kuenda paunoriwana nechigunwe. Anogara ipapo.
ABOUT_DISCLAIMER: Mutambo wakazvimirira. Matimu inyika dzinoshandisa mazita adzo akajairwa; zita remutambi wese rakagadzirwa. Hauna hukama nesangano rinotonga, ligi kana makwikwi api zvawo.
LICENCES_INTRO: Mutambo wakavakwa nesoftware yemahara uye yakavhurika. Marezenisi ayo anoda kuti zviziviso izvi zviratidzwe; zviri muChirungu, sezvazvakanyorwa.
RULES_COURT_TEXT: Mamita 30.5 kureba ne15.25 hupamhi, muzvikamu zvitatu. Pakati pane denderedzwa repakati remamita 0.9, uye kumagumo ega ega denderedzwa regora: hafu yedenderedzwa yemamita 4.9 kubva padanda. Mhete iri mamita 3.05 kumusoro, isina bhodhi kumashure.
RULES_TEAMS_TEXT: Mutambi wese anopfeka bhibhi rine nzvimbo yake, uye anopinda chete munzvimbo dzenzvimbo yake. Timu inodoma vatambi vanosvika gumi nevaviri; shanduko dzinoitwa pakuzorora, mushure mechibodzwa kana zvakumbirwa, uye kana paine akuvara.
RULES_GOAL_TEXT: Goal Shooter naGoal Attack chete ndivo vanogona kunwisa, uye vari mukati medenderedzwa regora chete. Bhora rinofanira kupfuura nemumhete chaimo. Kupfura kwabuda mumaoko ake pito isati yaridzwa kunoverengwa.
RULES_CENTRE_TEXT: Chikamu chega chega chinotanga nepasa yepakati, uye mutambo mushure mechibodzwa chega chega. Dzinochinjana, zvisinei nekuti ndiani anonwisa. Centre anomira mudenderedzwa repakati; vamwe vanomirira muzvikamu zvavo zvegora kusvikira pito yaridzwa, uye pasa inofanira kubatirwa muchikamu chepakati.
RULES_TIME_TEXT: Zvikamu zvina zvemaminitsi 15, nemaminitsi mana pakati pechekutanga nechechipiri, nepakati pechechitatu nechechina, uye gumi nemaviri pahafu. Matimu anochinja mativi chikamu chega chega.
RULES_EXTRA_TEXT: Kana mutambo uchifanira kuva nemukundi uye makaenzana: hafu mbiri dzisingapfuuri maminitsi manomwe neminiti imwe pakati, wozoenderera kusvikira timu imwe yatungamira nezvibodzwa zviviri.
RULES_FOOTWORK_TEXT: Ane bhora haagoni kumhanya. Tsoka yaanotanga kumhara nayo ndiyo tsoka yekumhara: anogona kutsika neimwe achitenderera pane yekumhara, asi kana aisimudza anofanira kupasa kana kupfura isati yadzoka pasi. Pasa yemahara kune rimwe divi.
RULES_THREE_TEXT: Anofanira kupasa kana kupfura mukati memasekondi matatu abata bhora. Kunonoka nebhora: pasa yemahara.
RULES_OBSTRUCTION_TEXT: Mudziviriri anoedza kuvhara kana kutora bhora anofanira kumira mamita 0.9 kana kupfuura kubva patsoka yekumhara yemutambi ane bhora. Kana ari pedyo kupfuura ipapo, kuvharira: pasa yepenariti.
RULES_CONTACT_TEXT: Hapana kubatana kunokanganisa mutambo wemupikisi: kusundidzira, kubata, kurova bhora kubva mumaoko ake, kana kusasiyira mutambi abata bhora nzvimbo yekumhara. Pasa yepenariti.
RULES_OFFSIDE_TEXT: Mutambi anopinda munzvimbo isingabvumirwe nzvimbo yake, ane bhora kana asina, ari ofusaidhi. Mitsetse iri chikamu chenzvimbo dzainokomberedza. Pasa yemahara.
RULES_THIRD_TEXT: Bhora harigoni kukandwa richipfuura chikamu chose pasina mutambi ari muchikamu ichocho arigama kana kuribata. Pasa yemahara.
RULES_SHORT_TEXT: Panofanira kuva nenzvimbo yekuti mupikisi abvute pakati pemukandi nemugami. Pasa yemahara.
RULES_OUT_TEXT: Bhora rinowira kunze kwenhandare rinopiwa divi risina kuribata pekupedzisira: rinokandwa mukati kubva paryakayambuka mutsetse, mukati memasekondi matatu.
RULES_PENALTIES_TEXT: Pasa yemahara inotorwa papakaitwa mhosva, nemutambi chero anobvumirwa ipapo. Papasa yepenariti, mutambi arangwa anomira parutivi pemukandi, asingatambe, kusvikira bhora rasunungurwa. Mudenderedzwa regora, penariti inogona kuva pasa kana kupfura.
RULES_ADVANTAGE_TEXT: Mutongi anorega mutambo uchienderera kana kuumisa kwaizokuvadza timu yakatadzirwa: semupfuri ava kuda kupfura. Anodana mukana uye mhosva.
RULES_SANCTIONS_TEXT: Pamutambo unodzokororwa kana une njodzi, mutongi anogona kuyambira mutambi, kumumisa kwemaminitsi maviri enguva yekutamba, kana kumubudisa. Kubva muna 2024 hapachina toss-up: kana vatambi vaviri vakanganisa panguva imwe, timu yanga ine bhora pekupedzisira inoramba nayo.
RULES_DZ_TEXT: Mamwe maligi ane mitemo yakasiyana. Mutambo uyu une Double Zone: mumaminitsi 5 ekupedzisira echikamu chega chega, chibodzwa chinobva pa3 m kana kupfuura kubva padanda chinopa zviviri.
CTRL_MOVE_TEXT: Chigunwe cheruboshwe chero kupi kuruboshwe rwechiratidziro ijoystick: chinomhanyisa mutambi wako (mhete yegirini yakajeka). Mhanyira munzvimbo isina munhu kuti uwane pasa.
CTRL_PASS_TEXT: Ane bhora haagoni kumhanya. Sundira joystick kuna waunotamba naye kuti umusarudze (mhete inoratidza kuti ndiani), wobva wadzvanya PASA kuti upase pachipfuva kana pafudzi, kana MUDENGA kuti ripfuure pamusoro pemudziviriri. Mhete iri pamusoro pebhora ndiwo masekondi ako matatu.
CTRL_SHOOT_TEXT: PFURA inobuda kana Goal Shooter kana Goal Attack wako ane bhora mudenderedzwa. Pedyo zvinonyanya kuva nechokwadi; ruoko rwemudziviriri pamusoro pebhora runozviomesa.
CTRL_DEFEND_TEXT: DZIVIRIRA inosimudza maoko ako pamusoro pebhora. Tarisa mhete yakatenderedza tsoka yake yekumhara: girini zvinobvumirwa, tsvuku zviri pedyo kupfuura mamita 0.9 uye mutongi achadana kuvharira.
CTRL_INTERCEPT_TEXT: BVUTA inosvetukira pasa iri mudenga kana uchigona kuisvika nenguva. Ukakwakuka mutambi abata bhora, kubatana.
CTRL_PLAY_AS_TEXT: Paunotamba setimu, unotonga ane bhora, uye CHINJA inokuendesa kumudziviriri ari pedyo nebhora. Sarudza bhibhi pachiratidziro chekutanga kuti utambe nzvimbo imwe mutambo wose.
CTRL_KEYS_TEXT: WASD kana miseve kufamba, Space bhatani rekutanga, J naK mamwe, Esc kumbomira.
TEAM_CHANGES_NOTE: Dzvanya nzvimbo kuti upinze mutambi anotevera ari pabhenji anotamba nzvimbo iyoyo.
CUP_ABOUT: Nyika sere dziri pedyo neyako pachinzvimbo chepasi rose, mumapoka maviri evana. Mbiri dzepamusoro muboka rega rega dzinopinda musemi-fainari; mushure mezvo fainari nemutambo webhuronzi. Mapoinzi maviri pakukunda, rimwe pamaenzana; kuenzana kunogadziriswa nepesenti yezvibodzwa.
RECORDS_EMPTY: Tamba mutambo, nhoroondo yako inotangira pano.
TIMEOUTS_NOTE: Mutemo weligi: divi rega rega rinogona kudana nguva mbiri dzekuzorora dzemasekondi 90 pahafu, mushure mechibodzwa. Yako iri mumenyu yekumbomira.
ROLLING_NOTE: Mutemo weligi: ita shanduko dzetimu chero nguva kubva mumenyu yekumbomira, kwete pakuzorora chete.
TIME_OUT_NOTE: Masekondi 90, wachi yamiswa. Ita shanduko dzetimu izvozvi; dzvanya Enderera kana wagadzirira.
INJURY_NOTE: Mutambi we{team} akuvara. Timu ine masekondi 30 kumubatsira kubuda; matimu ese anogona kuchinja vatambi. Dzvanya Enderera kana wagadzirira.
UMP_FEWER_NOTE: Vamwe vatambi vanopa hafu chete yemapenariti akajairika.
UMP_STANDARD_NOTE: Chikamu chimwe muzvitatu chemapenariti emutambo wenyanzvi, kuti mutambo uyerere.
UMP_REAL_NOTE: Mapenariti akawanda semumutambo wenyanzvi: anenge 50 patimu mumaminitsi 60.
COACH_TIPS_NOTE: Mazano mapfupi mumutambo, rimwe nerimwe paunorida kekutanga. Anodzima kana wapedza mutambo wako wekutanga wose.
COACH_MOVE: Famba nejoystick iri kuruboshwe. Unotamba ane mhete yegirini yakajeka; mavara ari pabhibhi rake anoratidza kwaanogona kuenda.
COACH_PASS: Une bhora: haugoni kumhanya naro, uye unofanira kupasa mumasekondi matatu. Dzvanya {pass} kukandira kumhete yemitsetse, kana kutanga wanongedzera joystick kune mumwe.
COACH_SHOOT: Uri mudenderedzwa regora: dzvanya {shoot}. Paunoswedera padanda, ndipo paunopfura zvakanaka.
COACH_FOOTWORK: Wakabata bhora unomira: joystick inongokutendeudza. {lob} inokanda bhora pamusoro pemudziviriri murefu.
COACH_DEFEND: Ivo vane bhora. Mhanyira kumutambi umurinde. {defend} inosimudza maoko ako, asi gara mamita 0.9 kumashure: mhete inova tsvuku kana wanyanya kuswedera.
COACH_INTERCEPT: Pasa iri mudenga: dzvanya {intercept} kuti uisvetukire. {switch} inokuendesa kune waunotamba naye ari pedyo nebhora.
COACH_WHISTLE: Pito: chiziviso chiri kumusoro chinotaura kuti chii, uye kuti timu ipi ine bhora zvino.
COACH_AREAS: Nzvimbo imwe neimwe ine zvikamu zvayo zvenhandare: ukabuda mazviri, ofusaidhi. Mamepu ari muMatambiro.
MENU_LEAGUE_DESC: Makirabhu masere, marawundi manomwe, wobva mafainari.
MENU_LEAGUE_CONTINUE: Mwaka wako uri kuenderera. Ramba uchitamba.
LEAGUE_ABOUT: Makirabhu masere ekuAustralia, New Zealand, Ingirandi neSouth Africa anotambirana kamwe chete. Mana epamusoro anopinda mumafainari: rekutanga rinotamba rechina, rechipiri rinotamba rechitatu, uye vakunda vanosangana mufainari huru. Mapoinzi maviri pakukunda, rimwe pamaenzana; kuenzana kunogadziriswa nepesenti yezvibodzwa.
LEAGUE_OUT: Kirabhu yako haina kupinda mumafainari. Mafainari anoenderera usipo.
